svg.text: To reach an agreement or solve a problem after a lot of
work out through negotiation; settle through discussion
The team spent all morning hammering out the final
Separable: hammer out the details / hammer them out.
Suggests a process of shaping something through
persistent negotiation. With a noun, both orders work;
pronouns go between the verb and particle.
A: Are we ready to sign?
B: Not yet, we still need to hammer out the payment
B: It is, but we are making progress.
Model Answer: hammer out the agreement
